requirements.literal_contract_summary: A functioning application; truthful profile/document/answer facts; thresholds, rate/company limits and quality/confidence/sensitive/source gates; challenge intervention without bypass; supported form recognition, classification, uploads, questions, multipage validation, enabled submission, confirmation, persistent sessions and recovery.
requirements.closure_limit: The sprint delivers real code and strengthens truth-preserving failure/retry behavior, but it is not a complete audit and executed proof of this overarching capability and safety contract.

requirements.title: BOUND EXTERNAL OPERATIONS
requirements.literal_contract_summary: Timeouts, captured output, controlled cancellation, retry policy and error classification across HTTP, browser navigation/selectors, AI, parsing, OCR, external processes, source collectors and ATS collectors; no worker permanently blocked on one source.
requirements.closure_limit: Carry forward prior bounded-operation evidence and append the frontend/native-DOM/socket slices. A current complete surface-to-control proof is not established. Raw CDP response decoding precedes retained caps; diagnostic filesystem work is checkpointed, not hard-preempted.

Canonical limits retain physical host restart and incomplete queue/worker recovery proof, including actual RQ maintenance redelivery and named Redis interruption opt-in.

requirements.title: IMPLEMENTATION PHASES

requirements.closure_limit: Test totals and focused new regressions do not establish all listed behavior cells. Each cell needs an executed meaningful oracle, exact source identity and explicit skip/failure accounting.

requirements.title: DEFINITION OF DONE
requirements.literal_contract_summary: Coherent end-to-end operation of the listed major workflows, including several working real ATS adapters, recovery, 24/7 scheduling and Docker persistence.

requirements.literal_contract_summary: All 70 actual deliverables, including complete backend/frontend, real source/application integrations, company monitoring, automation/review controls, recovery assets, complete end-to-end CI, verification utility and final report.
requirements.closure_limit: No complete functional and executed inventory of all 70 deliverables is established. File presence or a generated checklist is insufficient.

requirements.literal_contract_summary: A compact but thorough completion report covering architecture, file changes, services, every source and supported ATS capability/limitation, company discovery, dedupe, matching, documents, actual test commands/results, external limitations, exact startup, limitations and meaningful next work.
requirements.closure_limit: A sprint handoff can satisfy reporting needs for this slice; it does not demonstrate the complete product-level final report and its underlying verified capability inventory.

requirements.title: IMPORTANT FAILURE RULE
requirements.literal_contract_summary: When a source or ATS changes, investigate supported API/public endpoint/HTML/structured-data/ATS/browser approaches; retain the subsystem and classify an unstable integration while continuing other work.
requirements.closure_limit: Report observed sprint compliance as process evidence. The selected canonical row has no accepted whole-requirement evidence; do not manufacture a P0 PASS merely because this sprint did not remove a subsystem.

requirements.title: IMPORTANT AUTONOMY RULE
requirements.literal_contract_summary: Execute authorized implementation and testing while preserving explicit prohibitions on invented credentials/facts, bypasses, random external submissions and unrelated or destructive host changes; change the implementation approach when needed.
requirements.closure_limit: The sprint authorization and preserved external-submission/no-paid-AI boundaries are compliance evidence. They are not a newly verified product capability or an administrative P0 acceptance shortcut.

requirements.closure_limit: The sprint improves parts of this chain; the complete continuous/recoverable architecture has not been demonstrated end-to-end.
